An array containing the topics that this user can replicate to.
When this field is present, the value of the field must be an array of
strings that specify topic names or regular expressions. For
example, the following entry allows this user to replicate ONLY to
topics that begin with /orders/NYC
"replicated-topics":["^/orders/NYC/.*"]
If this field is not present in the permissions document, the user
cannot replicate to any topics.
